title: Two further baselines from the ADAPT-Z paper: ADCSD and OGD, seeds 2025-2027
frozen_at: 2026-10-11, before any trajectory or result of these methods
selection_rule: baselines used in the ADAPT-Z paper (external/adaptz README), online methods applicable to the same frozen iTransformer backbone as On-Adapter, ADAPT-Z, Proceed and SOLID; chosen by the user before any result
common: backbone = the same seed's V1 main-table iTransformer checkpoint (rebuilt with the package that trained it, as for SOLID); CPU replay over the test origins in order; entry seed 100 x seed; after each forecast, one update on the batch_size most recent test origins whose H-step targets are fully observed (origin_c + H <= current origin), batch_size = the cell's resolved benchmark batch size; masked MSE on observed targets; no tuning, author code defaults
ADCSD: external/adaptz/ADCSD.py: frozen backbone output F(x) (B,H,N,1); y = F(x) + lambda_1*g_1(res) + lambda_2*g_2(trend), series_decomp moving average 5 along the horizon, g = Linear(1,128)-LayerNorm([H,N,128])-GELU-Linear(128,1), lambda per variable initialised at 0; Adam lr 1e-4, eps 1e-8; backbone frozen
OGD: external/adaptz/parameter_finetune.py: SGD lr 3e-6, one step per origin (ogd_step 1), on the output projection layer. The pinned code names the layer 'projectio' (typo), which would unfreeze nothing and skip all updates; the intended layer 'projection' (tslib iTransformer) is used. Model in eval mode (no dropout).
reporting: results recorded in full under reports/v1ext_20261011; inclusion in the paper decided by the user
